news.headline: EQT Corporation Announces Strategic Acquisition of Range Resources
news.summary: EQT Corporation has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Range Resources Corporation in an all-stock transaction to create a leading natural gas producer.

news.headline: EQT Corporation To Acquire Range Resources In All-Stock Deal Valuing One RRC Share At 0.987 EQT Share With Pro Forma EV Of $50B+
